prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity full-page desktop website illustration of Quran Universe, a Quran reading and study app. Flat front-facing interface filling image edge to edge, not a monitor photograph. Tall portrait canvas approximately 1440 x 2200. Complete page from top navigation to footer. Elegant serif display typography with clean sans-serif UI and readable Arabic surah names. Same shared design for all texture studies.
FIXED PALETTE: warm ivory page #F6F5EF, smooth cream cards #FFFEF9, dark ink text #233735, deep teal buttons #22665E, sparse muted gold ornaments #B49661. Maintain this LIGHT theme across whole page. No dark panels.
FIXED COMPOSITION: slim header with "Quran Universe" left; "Quran", "Timeline", "Names of Allah" right. Two-column hero, left eyebrow "READ · REFLECT · UNDERSTAND", headline "Every verse, made easy to understand", subtitle "Explore the Quran with translations, context, and reflections.", teal pill button "Start reading". Right: 3-by-3 popular surah cards, each gold outlined small number ornament, short Arabic surah name and English labels Al-Fatihah, Ayat al-Kursi, Al-Kahf, Ya-Sin, Ar-Rahman, Al-Waqi'ah, Al-Mulk, Maryam, Yusuf. Next row of three exploration tiles "The Quran", "Timeline", "Names of Allah". Next "A moment of reflection", wide SMOOTH cream reading card with small label "AL-FATIHAH · 1:1", exact translation "In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.", and three compact columns "Understand", "Reflect", "Practice". Next "Explore the surahs", search field, six tidy surah rows in two columns. Footer brand with "Read with understanding".
STYLE: graceful editorial spacing, crisp thin warm borders, small soft shadows, restrained ornament. Content cards remain opaque smooth cream; background texture only in exposed page canvas, margins, gaps, header and footer. Texture should be visible enough to compare in the illustration, but delicate enough for reading. No invented Arabic verses, people, scenery, photos, device framing, floating swatches, texture samples, or separate inset panels. This is a complete website illustration, not a texture board.
Include a small clear footer label naming the texture study as specified. Change only background treatment, preserve layout and base colors.

BACKGROUND TREATMENT: refined uncoated cotton paper in warm ivory, with subtle irregular fine fibers and gentle natural tonal variation. Clean contemporary stationery, not antique parchment. No stains, creases, torn edges, yellowing, speckles or canvas weave. Visible mainly in broad hero background and outside cream cards. No grid or glow or gradient. Footer label: "01 · Soft paper".
